THE ICONIC QUEEN OF CRIME RETURNS . . .

Don't miss the brand-new, explosive novel from the one and only Martina Cole, back writing solo and at the top of her game.

Doing time runs in the family . . .

Johnny Raglan's been sent down for life, and to him it's just another adventure.

His mother Dolly has been through it all before, so she knows the score. And she takes it upon herself to show Johnny's wife Janey what it takes to survive.

But Dolly can't control her other son Jimmy. He has taken over the family business, but when rumours start to spread that he isn't to be trusted all hell breaks loose.

For if there's one thing the Raglans won't tolerate, it's disloyalty...
